name: claude-config-backup
description: Portable backup of personal Claude Code skills, agents, slash commands, and plugin/hook config. An agent installs this onto any box's ~/.claude.

mergeSettings.notes: MERGE, do not overwrite. statusLine holds a box-specific plugin-cache path with a version hash and a Windows path; drop it if it does not resolve on the target. Caveman hook + statusline come from the caveman@caveman marketplace plugin declared here — they reinstall after a Claude Code restart.

handsOff.note: Global instructions are personal per-box (identity, token-rotation dates, absolute paths). Do NOT auto-overwrite. Copy to CLAUDE.md.from-repo beside target and let the agent/user diff+merge.

notSynced: session state (projects/ sessions/ tasks/ telemetry/ shell-snapshots/ file-history/)
